narrative:
## Handover Summary — Pricing & Gross-to-Net

Price and GTN assumptions are locked by brand-indication and market.

## Key Decisions
• European net price index planned 3 points lower for JCA and AMNOG
• Strensiq US GTN up 2pp on Medicaid mix
• Soliris US GTN up 3pp during biosimilar entry

## Recommendation for Rare Disease P&L
Consolidate with GTN pressure shown as a separate bridge step, so the CFO can see the price-volume trade-off explicitly.
